I have been using Cornitos tortilla chips for more than two years now. I am happy to find them on Amazon as their availability at local grocers is limited at best. Out of all the brands making tortilla chips in India, Cornitos is the best. I have tried all three of Cornitos original flavors, namely Sizzlin Jalapeno, Cheese and Herbs, and Tomato Mexicana. Will soon try their two new flavors that I discovered on Amazon.I have almost always paired these tortilla chips with homemade pico de gallo (salsa fresca) and guacamole so read the next couple of sentences with that flavor profile in mind. These chips are simply delicious and a gastronomic delight. They are crispy enough to give the necessary crunch, yet not hard enough to scratch your gums. The other brands should learn from Cornitos, especially Salsalito whose chips are way too crispy and have injured my gums and mouth whenever I was silly enough to try them.In terms of the flavor, I like the three original Cornitos varieties in this order:(1) Sizzling Jalapeno(2) Cheese and Herbs(3) Tomato MexicanaSizzling Jalapeno is best for pairing with pico de gallo due to its subtle flavor. Cheese and Herbs reminds me of Doritos (not yet available in India) and is good as it is. Tomato Mexicana has a strong tomato flavor that does not go well with salsa; some people might also find it too tangy.You are missing out on so many flavors if you have not tried these chips with salsa yet. Overall, I can not recommend these Cornitos chips enough.PRO TIP: Take the chips out of the packet and microwave them for a few seconds (15-20 secs) for fresh oven-baked taste and flavor.If you found this information helpful, please hit "yes" below to encourage me to write more reviews :)
